title.narrative: Partner Identification between Youth association of Natural Science Denmark (UNF) and Livid open Lab

description.narrative: UNF have been introduced to Lviv Open Lab, when the two members were in Denmark with the Danish/Ukraine house. Here we discovered we had numerous mutual interests. The purpose of Lviv Open Lab is to inspire the youth in Lviv to natural science by the use of experiments and after one exercise. UNF�s purpose is to spread the interest in the natural sciences to the youth in Denmark. UNF has many years of experience with science activities such as sciencecamps, workshops, evening lectures, field trips etc. The purpose of the Partner Identification is to get a better understanding between our two organisations, and from this learn how we can work together to promote the natural Sciences, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) to the youth in both Ukraine and in Denmark. Another reasons for doing the collaboration is to exchange experience and strength and in the future collaborate on a bigger project, for example a sciencecamp with participants from both Lviv and Denmark.
